exposure: intrapartum HI basal ganglia-thalamic (BGT) pattern injury
cohort: 10 medicolegal cases of neonatal encephalopathy-cerebral palsy survivors
finding: A prolonged nonreassuring fetal status during labor may lead to basal ganglia-thalamic hypoxic-ischemic injury even in the absence of a specific perinatal sentinel event.
mod_finding: The majority of infants (60%) were delivered by unassisted vaginal birth, while four were delivered by delayed caesarean section.
